Subject: Summit Health — proposed eval plan and MAP

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team found the latency numbers compelling. We want to move from a short eval to a formal 3‑phase evaluation (pilot → expand → production) and have sketched a Mutual Action Plan (attached) that ties milestone acceptance to a phased commercial commitment.

High level:
- Pilot (60 days): baseline integration, synthetic load + small production pilot with 50 seats.
- Expand (90 days): ramp to 500 seats, performance gates.
- Production: 12‑month contract with committed throughput and support.

Two asks up front:
1) Can Redwood accommodate a milestone‑based discount (we proposed 25% initial discount for pilot + 20% in expand, ramping down to 10% for production)?
2) Any ability to provide an onboarding credit to cover migration (we estimated $25k).

Attached: Summit_MAP_v1.pdf for the MAP and an initial risk matrix. Procurement and Legal will need standard SSO/KMS details and SOC2 evidence — we can share their specific questionnaire separately.

Emily Jones
Director, Digital Platforms
Summit Health
Attachment: Summit_MAP_v1.pdf (PDF)

Emily — thanks for the clear plan and for laying out the milestones. I've looped in Aditya (AE) to work the commercials and Monica (CS) on technical acceptance criteria so we align on the MAP gates.

A couple quick clarifying questions before we propose formal terms:
- Are the milestone acceptance criteria subjective (product manager signoff) or do you prefer objective test harness metrics (p99 < X ms, error rate < Y)?
- Can you confirm the expected average daily token volume in pilot vs expand so we size the infra?

We’ll draft a MAP that mirrors your phases and include a pricing table with a conditional discount schedule tied to milestone completion. I’ll try to get a draft out by Monday.

Folks — attaching a working commercial package for Summit. Key points:

- Term: 12 months, start on SOW signature.
- Commitment: $420k ARR equivalent (phased ramp) with a 6‑month ramp target to 75% committed capacity.
- Discount schedule (conditional on MAP milestones):
  • Pilot acceptance: 20% off list for applicable model family for months 1–2
  • Expand acceptance: 15% off list for months 3–6
  • Production (post‑ramp): 10% ongoing discount for the remainder of year 1
- Onboarding credit: one‑time $20,000 credit to be applied to first invoice (to offset migration/integration effort).
- Performance gates: define objective metrics (p95 latency < 300ms, 99th < 700ms, success rate > 99.5%) — Monica to confirm.

Attachments: MAP_v3.pdf (updated MAP), SOW-draft.docx, onboarding-credit-breakdown.xlsx

Two commercial asks that need finance approval:
1) Approve one‑time onboarding credit ($20k) — threshold for exec signoff?
2) Allow us to commit to 20% initial pilot discount (this is above our standard autopricing guardrail).

If we can get a quick thumbs from Finance (Laura) and Revenue Ops (Vivek) I’ll send a clean version to Emily/Procurement.
